installerBytes.method: Byte size of the versioned NSIS x64 setup candidate.

coldStartMs.method: Wall time from CreateProcess for an isolated installed candidate to authenticated Receiver discovery.

idleWorkingSetBytes.method: Sum of WorkingSetSize for the installed Electron Shell process tree after Receiver ready and a 1 second idle settle.

activeWorkingSetBytes.method: Sum of WorkingSetSize for the same process tree after 300 authenticated OTLP log requests and projection settle.

receiverRequestsPerSecond.method: 300 authenticated one-record OTLP/HTTP requests at concurrency 16, divided by wall time; every response must be accepted.
